data.name: KelvinSeek
data.shortDescription: Adds the ability to talk with Kelvin using DeepSeek AI
data.description:
## KelvinSeek
### Deepseek-Powered Kelvin Mod for Sons of the Forest

Imagine asking kelvin one of these things

- "Kelvin can you get me some wood?"
- "Kelvin how are you feeling today?"
- "Its getting late, make a shelter real quick"

Now you can!

[Video demonstration](https://youtu.be/tcC9ammD8NU)

Seamlessly integrates into the Sons of the Forest game. By leveraging the capabilities of ChatGPT, Kelvin becomes more responsive and engaging, providing a unique gaming experience.

## Installation

1. Download the KelvinGPT mod
2. Drop the mod .zip in your game folder and extract
3. Launch the game and start enjoying the enhanced interaction with Kelvin.

## How to Use

1. In the game, approach Kelvin and press the "E" key to open the notepad.
2. Press the "T" key to activate text input mode.
3. Start typing anything you want, questions, commands or interactions with Kelvin and press Enter.

## Commands

The mods add 2 console commands
- askkelvin recieves a command and will send it to kelvin without you needing to open the notepad for example
`askkelvin Hello kelvin, can you get me some wood?`
- clearkelvinchathistory Clears the chat history with kelvin
`clearkelvinchathistory`

(These commands work on the last kelvin you talked to, so in order to use them you must first send a message to kelvin via notepad)

*Explore the world of Sons of the Forest in a whole new way with the KelvinSeek mod.*

( Previously known as KelvinGPT / Kelvin-GPT )

Disclaimer: Last update do not require you to use open ai / deepseek api key so all messages are sent to the sotf-mods server for processing which calls the external AI service and stores the message and response for future training purposes
